verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships an official CLI that gives 'AI agents and scripts full access' to workspaces. It exposes the APIs through a single `cio api` command with structured JSON output and self-describing schemas, and it sits alongside documented REST APIs (Track, App, Pipelines) and a published OpenAPI spec. Together these support headless, scripted automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance (non-interactive auth/tokens for CI runners, example pipeline configs), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces.
It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command—no per-endpoint code, no SDK boilerplate.
Every command returns structured JSON, every endpoint is self-describing via `cio schema`
To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
